en: A black-and-white historical photograph showing a grand procession through a city street. At the center is an open automobile carrying uniformed military figures, surrounded by French soldiers with bayonets and a large crowd of civilians. The background shows early 20th-century European architecture with visible shop signs. The scene is jubilant and appears to mark a significant public event.
